item.title: Huawei Unveils First HarmonyOS Desktop, Qingyun HM650, with Kirin X90 Chip
item.description:
Huawei launched the Qingyun HM650, its first HarmonyOS desktop, at the HarmonyOS Office Industry Summit, pairing HarmonyOS V1.0 with the in-house Kirin X90 chip (10 cores, 20 threads) for government and enterprise fixed-workstation use. The company touts hardware-software-chip-cloud co-optimization, system-level AI and full-stack security, claiming 100% domestic component sourcing and over 21,000 native HarmonyOS PC apps.

原文标题：华为发布首款鸿蒙台式机擎云 HM650 搭载麒麟 X90

Why it matters：这是鸿蒙生态向台式机形态延伸的节点性硬件发布，但核心信息以厂商宣传口径为主，缺乏第三方性能数据。

item.title: Baidu Open-Sources ERNIE 5.5 Flash Base, a 280B Sparse MoE Model
item.description:
Baidu has open-sourced the pretraining-endpoint weights of ERNIE-5.5-Flash-Base, a sparse MoE language model with 280B total parameters and 14B activated per token, pretrained from scratch on 33.5T tokens with up to 1M-token context for fine-tuning and inference. The weights are released without mid- or post-training, positioned as a shared starting point for domain adaptation, instruction tuning and RL research, with the post-trained ERNIE 5.5 Flash to follow.

原文标题：百度开源 ERNIE 5.5 Flash Base 基座模型 总参数 280B

Why it matters：国产大厂罕见开源 280B 级稀疏 MoE 基座权重，并披露 Muon 优化器与 FP8 训练细节，对基座模型研究与二次开发有直接价值。

item.title: Foxconn October Revenue Hits Record NT$1.3 Trillion on AI Demand
item.description:
Foxconn reported October revenue of NT$1.305 trillion, up 45.7% year-over-year and a record for any single month, with cumulative ten-month revenue up 40.4%. The company said its AI business will keep growing in Q4, reinforcing strong demand across the AI server supply chain.

Growth was attributed to AI server order spillover and recovering board demand, though the filing discloses no AI-specific revenue breakdown or order details.

item.title: Google Ties School Search Access to Gemini Opt-In, Drawing Political Backlash
item.description:
Google announced that K-12 schools using its education software must opt in to AI tools such as Gemini, or students will lose access to Google Search, arguing that search and AI are now deeply integrated. The move, disclosed on U.S. midterm election day, drew swift criticism from politicians including Bernie Sanders, Richard Blumenthal and Lina Khan, who called it extortionate and anti-competitive. Google said access is off by default and schools can separately enable Gemini, Gemini Notebook and Search.

原文标题：谷歌要求学校启用 Gemini 才能使用搜索，引发政界批评

Why it matters：这是大厂将 AI 捆绑进关键基础设施的标志性事件，直接触及教育场景的 AI 准入与反垄断边界。

item.description:

item.title: Anthropic Uses Claude to Find Vault Protein Relatives in Bacteria
item.description:
Anthropic's biology team used Claude to show for the first time that bacterial and phage relatives of vault proteins can assemble into vault particles, cutting particle isolation from about three days to 90 minutes and producing a first 3D structure model in 34 hours. The project took under four months, with researchers deciding and Claude executing and suggesting, demonstrating LLM productivity in structural biology discovery.

原文标题：Anthropic 用 Claude 在细菌中找到穹窿体同类蛋白

Why it matters：这是 LLM 直接参与真实科学发现并显著压缩实验周期的少见案例，对关注 AI for Science 的读者有实质参考价值。

item.title: Meta Acquires AI Coding Startup Conductor to Bolster Agentic Coding
item.description:

The founder will join Meta Superintelligence Labs, while Conductor's cloud service shuts down on November 20 and core features continue until early next year. The deal marks another step in Meta's push to catch up in agentic coding.

item.title: MIT's Astra Weight-Editing Study Challenged Over Conflated Claims
item.description:
Matthew Honnibal, creator of spaCy, publicly challenged MIT's viral Astra study, arguing it conflates two very different experimental setups—reading raw weights versus using code tools to modify them—into a single 'read-write AI brain' narrative. He nonetheless concedes that having an LLM autonomously write code to diagnose and repair another model's weights is a genuine engineering advance; the issue lies in how the results were framed.

原文标题：MIT Astra 权重编辑研究遭质疑 被指混淆两种技术路径

Why it matters：对爆火研究的公开质疑，揭示了 AI 成果传播中的夸大包装问题，对判断模型能力边界有参考价值。

item.title: Uber Says Only Four Rides Were Booked by AI Agents in Halloween Week
item.description:
Uber disclosed on its Q3 earnings call that only four rides were booked via AI agents during its highest-volume week in October (Halloween week), versus roughly 500 Uber Eats orders placed by agents out of about 320 million total trips and orders. CEO Dara Khosrowshahi called traction very limited but remains optimistic about net-new demand, noting that all major AI assistant companies are in talks with Uber. DoorDash reported similarly marginal agent-driven order volumes.

原文标题：Uber 财报披露：万圣节周仅 4 笔订单由 AI 智能体叫车

Why it matters：这是迄今最直白的上市公司数据，量化了 AI 智能体在真实交易场景中的采用率之低，为智能体热潮提供了难得的冷思考参照。

item.title: Counterpoint: Global DRAM Revenue Nears $200B in Q3, Up 369% YoY
item.description:
Counterpoint reports global DRAM revenue reached nearly $200B in Q3 2026, up 369% year over year, while unit shipments rose only about 4% sequentially, meaning growth was almost entirely price-driven. AI has turned memory from a commodity into a scarce resource; HBM4 competition and a GPU-to-CPU ratio trending toward 1:1 are reshaping vendor standings, and supply tightness is expected to persist as new fabs won't come online until 2028.

原文标题：Counterpoint：三季度全球 DRAM 营收近 2000 亿美元 同比增 369%

Why it matters：这是 AI 算力需求向内存侧传导的关键数据点，直接关系到芯片供应链与成本判断。

item.title: Google Research Releases Agile Deliberation Framework for Human-AI Concept Definition
item.description:
Google Research has open-sourced Agile Deliberation, a framework that lets users define fuzzy 'gray area' concepts before an AI classifier learns them. The system splits a concept into in-scope and out-of-scope subconcepts, surfaces borderline samples for user labeling, and has Gemini rewrite the definition as a VLM prompt. Across 18 live sessions it beat zero-shot Gemini 2.5 Flash by 10.5 F1 points on average, with code released under Apache 2.0.

原文标题：Google Research 发布 Agile Deliberation 框架，人机协作定义模糊概念

Why it matters：提供可复现的人机协作概念对齐方法与开源代码，对做视觉分类与提示工程的读者有直接参考价值。

item.title: Discord Drops Electron for Rust Rewrite, Cutting Client Memory to 290MB
item.description:
Discord has confirmed it is abandoning Electron and rewriting its desktop client in Rust, with the UI layer built on GPUI, the GPU-accelerated native UI framework from the Zed team, removing the bundled Chromium entirely. A screenshot with two accounts logged in shows roughly 290MB of memory use versus 1–2GB idle (up to 4GB) for the old Electron build. Mobile apps will also migrate from React Native to Rust while keeping native UI and sharing code with desktop; a user-facing beta is coming \\

原文标题：Discord 弃用 Electron，改用 Rust 重写客户端，内存占用降至 290MB

Why it matters：这是大型消费级应用告别 Electron、转向 Rust 原生渲染的标志性架构换血，对关心客户端性能与跨平台技术选型的开发者有直接参考价值。

item.title: User Jailbreaks NordicTrack Treadmill With Claude Code to Bypass iFIT Paywall
item.description:
A Reddit user used the AI coding tool Claude Code to modify a NordicTrack Commercial 2250 treadmill in roughly a day and a half, bypassing the mandatory iFIT subscription and replacing the locked-down 10-inch display with a custom home screen running Netflix and Crunchyroll. Netflix launch time reportedly dropped from nearly a minute to about 21 seconds, though playback is capped at SD, a factory reset erases the changes, and the modification carries safety and warranty risks. The value lies less in the anecdote itself than in what it shows about coding agents handling real-world hardware reverse engineering.

item.title: 斯坦福论文揭示上下文学习回路 模型靠查表匹配标签
item.description:
斯坦福一篇题为《A Circuit for In-Context Learning》的新论文指出，小模型的少样本能力并非真正“学会”新模式，而是靠标签查表：只有当同类标签在提示中重复出现时，模型才会触发这一查表机制。研究在 Qwen3-4B、SmolLM3-3B 与 Llama-3.2-3B 中追踪到完整路径——每个标签 token 存储所属句子类别，约 90 个靠后的注意力头负责将新句子与这些存储类别匹配。因此实用结论是：少样本提示中应重复每个标签，并只使用模型已能区分的类别，示例无法教给模型它本就缺失的特征。

Why it matters：该研究把少样本提示从经验技巧变成可追踪的电路机制，并给出可直接落地的提示设计结论，对关注 LLM 内在机理的读者信息增量明显。

item.title: SEMI：2026Q3 全球硅晶圆出货量同比增长 13.4%
item.description:
SEMI 旗下硅制造商组织公布，2026 年第三季度全球硅晶圆出货量达 37.56 亿平方英寸，约合 3321 万片 12 英寸晶圆，同比增长 13.4%、环比增长 5.1%。SEMI 将增长归因于 AI 相关需求从先进逻辑与存储器向功率器件、光子学延伸，同时机器人、AI 服务器电源与通用工业半导体的需求回暖。这一数据说明，AI 算力扩张的影响正向下游晶圆制造与先进封装环节传导。

Why it matters：这是观察 AI 算力需求如何传导至半导体上游的关键季度指标，数据来自官方统计，且具有可验证性。

item.title: Linux 内核被挖出 948 个漏洞！OpenAI 花 120 万美元找到的
item.description:
被轰成筛子了… > Jay 发自 凹非寺 > 量子位 | 公众号 QbitAI 刚刚，Linux内核，被GPT挖出了948个漏洞😭。 对，948个。。。 要知道，这可不是什么犄角旮旯的小软件，这是Linux Kernel，是安卓、是全世界无数云服务器、是几乎所有超算背后共同的心脏。 超过4000万行代码，几十年来全世界最顶尖的一批程序员在上面添砖加瓦。 结果，OpenAI用他们一个还没发布的「网络安全模型」，跑了一条自动化的流水线，从发现漏洞、验证漏洞、写出攻击代码（Exploit）…… 最终，花费120万美元，揪出了948个能让普通用户直接拿到最高管理员（root）权限的严重漏洞。。。 太惨了，Linux内核维护者们一觉醒来，发现OpenAI提出了948个补丁建议😭。 要知道，在AI出现之前，顶尖的人类安全研究员，一年能在Linux内核里找到大约20个类似的漏洞。 AI用10天，干了人类差不多50年的活。 而且成本还巨低。120万美元听着很多，但其实平均下来，找到并攻破一个漏洞的成本是1279美元。 如果按照Pwn2Own这种顶级黑客大赛的历史奖金来算，这948个漏洞的价值，大概在1...

item.title: 启元 T1 机器人推送首次 OTA，可识别楼梯并自动变形
item.description:
启元 T1 通过首次 OTA，将其“可变形”卖点落实为具体功能：跟随过程中识别楼梯并自动切换四足形态上下楼，同时新增 App 远程音视频通话、口语陪练、定时提醒与本体录像等家庭场景能力。但所有能力均来自厂商单方描述，没有实测视频、成功率数据或第三方验证，对多数读者而言，这条更像是消费级硬件动态，而非值得投入注意力的技术节点。

Why it matters：消费级可变形机器人首次 OTA，功能点具体但缺技术细节与实测佐证，属产品动态而非技术节点。
